implementers.role: implementer of reserve of the loop

non_conforming_sealed_records.rule: condition 2 of decision point 3: every listed record is excluded as evidence of any requirement, P0 included (scripts/validate_runtime_evidence.py requirement_evidence and the OCOR-DEV-0067 criteria in the backlog)

OCOR-DEV-0068.criterion: The independent adversarial review, on a clean clone with the stack recreated from scratch, finds every Core stage sharing verifiable trace and versions in the qualified mission thread; every critical/high finding becomes a REM and is closed before 0069.

The review re-derives, from the 0067 ledger and the raw logs, an individual outcome for every P0 PoC requirement and confirms zero failed P0 in the acceptance report; a P0 without criterion, evidence or individual outcome is a critical finding.
The reviewer reproduces the run from the same manifest, seed and versions within the declared tolerances and checks the separation between visible inputs and the evaluator's ground truth.

The review confirms zero actions without the required Decision/Authority/Approval, zero automatic promotion of claims or predictions, zero contamination of main, zero policy/audit bypass and zero lineage loss in the qualifying evidence.
The reviewer verifies the signatures of the evidence package and completes the clean-room replay.

OCOR-DEV-0069.criterion: The candidate package shows every P0 PoC passed, the evidence package complete, no untreated critical security/safety/licence risk and limitations and gaps listed for formal PO acceptance; status PROPOSED - AWAITING PRODUCT OWNER DECISION.
The acceptance report in the package lists an individual outcome per P0 with zero failed P0; one failed P0 makes the package non-approvable.
The package reports a separate outcome per gate and fails if any gate failed; a missing threshold blocks the PoC gate.
Every deliverable carries the disclaimer and coverage status; zero unsupported claims (no compliance, certification, Production readiness).

The bundle includes source/config, OaC/IR/compiler/build provenance, image digests, SBOM and licences, data/scenario/model manifests, seeds, policy bundle, raw outputs, traces/logs/receipts, lineage, capability matrix and limitations, signed and content-addressed.
The package states that no PoC outcome promotes the MVP or Production profiles.
No requirement reaches Verified through the package; Verified remains 0 until a governed transition with reviewer, timestamp, baseline and immutable evidence reference.

proposed_criteria_not_in_backlog.note: decision point 3: proposed requirement by requirement for the PO, not written in the backlog; OCOR-DEV-0068 and 0069 stay blocked (point 11). Acceptance text from the Requirement Register v1.1 (line in brackets).

regression_requalification_class.note: test_rejects_regression_record_failing_the_non_requirement_checks already passed at the RED head: it pins that the pre-existing non-requirement checks keep applying to the class

red.fingerprint_definition: sha256 of the sorted FAILED/SUBFAILED ids followed by the summary line

rules: a record with requalification_kind regression must declare qualifies_requirements false
it binds no case to a requirement: no requirement_results in the record and no manifest requirement_results row for its evidence path
supersedes equals previous_record.record_id; previous_record.record_path resolves with record_sha256 to a record with that record_id and the same task_id
every check that does not concern requirements still applies (commands, content-addressed raw log, PASS, zero failed/skipped/not_executed/xfailed counters, mandatory fields)
requirement_evidence never counts it: it is listed among rejected_records with the reason 'regression requalification record never qualifies a requirement'

condition_1.checks: a new record binding a case to a requirement its test does not declare is rejected; a G6 case binding a legacy test to an LLD identifier or qualifying an out-of-profile requirement is rejected

a new record whose case lacks any NFR-004 / LLD v1.1 §7.3 field (method, metric, threshold, baseline, dataset or scenario, result, owner, signature and the others) is rejected; a new record without cases is rejected
the case method must be the Register method; non-test methods need their method evidence
every test file traces to at least one requirement (ORPHAN_DESIGN otherwise); only named_in_test links are declarations

condition_2.checks: the sealed records are recognised by path and sha256 and the validator excludes them as evidence (requirement_evidence)
the OCOR-DEV-0067 criteria keep one ledger row per requirement, declare out-of-profile rows and exclude the non-conforming sealed records

condition_3.checks: per-requirement criteria and requirement_ids of OCOR-DEV-0060 and 0062-0067 from g6_g7_proposals minus g6_exclusions
OCOR-DEV-0061 is bound to FR-118 and FR-119 with the FGM cases the Register assigns
implementation allocation of FR-164, FR-045 and NFR-088

resolution_probes.rule: condition 4 of decision point 3: the probes check conditions 1-3, never counts over the sealed records; verification and verification_probes of the register are unchanged

resolved_register_entries_note: listed for resolution by this unit; resolution is established only by the sealed record at a verified head on main
